title: Geometric regularity of the closed fibre of a Noetherian local completion
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring, m its maximal ideal, and B its m-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. The closed fibre m.Fiber B [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is geometrically regular over m.ResidueField in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

source.place: Proposition Tag 07PX, proof of (3) and (4), expanded into the generic and closed fibre calculations; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PX

proof.text: Use the maximal-ideal residue-field algebra-map bijectivity to identify k with A/m. The completion evaluation at level one is surjective with kernel mB; its quotient equivalence identifies B/mB with A/m. This is the residue-field calculation of [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-local-ring], realized directly with AdicCompletion.ker_evalOneₐ_eq_map and evalOneₐ_surjective.

The ring-algebra quotient tensor equivalence quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor realizes [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-over-quotient-ring]. Compose it with the previous identifications to get k tensor_A B equivalent to k as an A-algebra. Extend scalars to k using surjectivity of A to k, giving a k-algebra equivalence.

Transport Noetherianity along this equivalence. For every finite purely inseparable extension kprime/k, tensor the equivalence with the identity of kprime and use the tensor right-unit equivalence. This identifies the base change with the field kprime, regular by [lem-weil-pbc-field-regular-ring]. This proves geometric regularity [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] in all residue characteristics.

lean.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyRegular_closedFiber
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] :
    Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).ResidueField
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))
